column1: # Pokémon Shining Pearl on Android: cloned from the sister release Brilliant Diamond (the same Unity 2019.4.27f1 / SDK 11.4.3 / shader tables), then played through on a device.
# On the 2410DPN6CC (Snapdragon 8 Elite, Adreno 830, Android 16) the game was played from the boot logos and the title screen to the end of the story, in Chinese, at 60 fps
# (frame work p50 10.4 ms in the field, 0 of 64 frames late); nx2android v0.4.0, a build made from this profile, gives the same and runs the title screen at p50 1.1 ms.
